title: atriplex cinerea subsp. bolusii
intro: Atriplex cinerea subsp. bolusii, commonly known as Bolus's saltbush, is a plant species within the Amaranthaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Bolus's saltbush include treating conditions like skin irritations, wounds, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and betalains.
